title: Pathway enrichment of resistance hits
prompt: Which gene set in pathways.gmt is most significantly over-represented among genes whose knockout confers resistance to helixin (FDR < 0.1)? Report the gene set name exactly as written in the GMT file.
grader_plain: Exact match: MISMATCH_REPAIR. Using sensitizers instead gives HOMOLOGOUS_RECOMBINATION; picking the set with the largest raw overlap with all significant genes gives RIBOSOME.
traps: Raw overlap instead of an enrichment test
context: You are analyzing a pooled CRISPR knockout screen. The workspace contains raw sgRNA read counts (counts.tsv), a sample sheet, gene sets and a short design document (design.md). Read design.md first.
